mcqs.learning_point: Identify angles created when lines intersect
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the angles formed when two straight lines intersect is incorrect?

options.D: The sum of any two adjacent angles is 180°.

mcqs.explanation: When two lines intersect, they create two pairs of equal vertical angles. Each pair of adjacent angles are supplementary, meaning they add up to 180°. Only in the special case where all angles are right angles would they all be equal, but in general the four angles are not all the same. Therefore statement C is the misconception.

mcqs.question: Two lines intersect forming four angles. If one of the angles measures 30°, which of the following statements is true?

options.A: The angle opposite the 30° angle also measures 30°.
options.B: The angle adjacent to the 30° angle also measures 30°.
options.D: The angle opposite the 30° angle measures 150°.

mcqs.answer: The angle opposite the 30° angle also measures 30°.
mcqs.explanation: Angles that are opposite each other when two lines intersect are called vertical angles, and they are always equal. Hence the angle opposite the given 30° angle must also be 30°. Adjacent angles are supplementary, so the adjacent angle would be 150°, not 30°, making options B, C, and D incorrect.

mcqs.learning_point: Use known angle information to determine unknown angles
mcqs.question: In a pair of intersecting lines, one acute angle measures x degrees and the obtuse angle adjacent to it measures 3x degrees. What are the measures of all four angles?
mcqs.explanation: Adjacent angles formed by intersecting lines are supplementary, so x + 3x = 180°. Solving gives 4x = 180°, thus x = 45°. The acute angles are 45° each, and the obtuse angles (3x) are 135° each. Therefore the four angles are 45°, 135°, 45°, 135°.

mcqs.question: Lines AB and CD intersect at O. ∠AOC = 2x and ∠BOC = 3x. If ∠AOC and ∠BOC are adjacent, what is the value of x and the measures of ∠AOC and ∠BOC?
mcqs.explanation: Adjacent angles formed by intersecting lines are supplementary, so 2x + 3x = 180°. This gives 5x = 180°, hence x = 36°. Substituting back, ∠AOC = 2x = 72° and ∠BOC = 3x = 108°. Option B correctly states these values.
